quote_attribution.claim: Measure what is measurable, and make measurable what is not so is widely attributed to Galileo, but lacks reliable primary attribution.

model: Native Full-HD Blender model with fine satin silver wire and fixed upper-end reference. A source ball approaches and follows the suspended ball. The separation angle determines distance; accumulated relative wire twist determines restoring torque. One comparison introduces the historical upper-knob reference; subsequent measurements and fitting retain the following-source view. Animation timing is illustrative, not a recorded trajectory or a dynamic numerical solution.
